notes: What 'Download ComfyUI' fetches. Everything is pinned: the portable archive by size and SHA-256 (the digest GitHub publishes for the release asset), the custom node by full commit id, the pip package by exact version.
The archive is a .7z; Windows' built-in tar.exe (bsdtar) unpacks it, so no extra extractor is downloaded.

older_gpus.note: The main build's PyTorch (CUDA 13) runs on NVIDIA cards from compute capability 7.5 (RTX 20 / GTX 16) up. Older cards (GTX 10 and earlier) get the CUDA 12.6 build of the same release, whose PyTorch is built for 5.0 to 9.0.

amd.note: ComfyUI's build for AMD cards from the same release (PyTorch 2.9.1 with ROCm 7.2.1). It carries code for gfx1100-1102 (RX 7000), gfx1150-1151 (Ryzen AI 300 and Ryzen AI Max) and gfx1200-1201 (RX 9000) only; older Radeons need ComfyUI's manual install (amd_instructions).
